event.name: Thousand Springs Festival of the Arts

notes.subject: 2026 reply — not a fit for Thousand Springs Festival format
notes.body: On Aug. 27, 2026, Jude Metzler, Project Coordinator for the Magic Valley Arts Council, declined Adventure Zone for Thousand Springs Festival of the Arts. Reasons: Thousand Springs State Park is small and grounds are prioritized for vendor booths and food trucks; MVAC intentionally wants the festival focused 100% on the arts and does not want a carnival-like theme; they feel inflatable attractions would distract from the festival's core idea. Current contact confirmed: Jude Metzler, Project Coordinator, magicvalleyartscouncil@magicvalleyartscouncil.org, 208-734-2787. Current MVAC programs reviewed include Art & Soul, Arts on Tour, Kids Art in the Park, Jazz on the Canyon, Missoula Children's Theater, gallery/classes, and Thousand Springs. These programs are also strongly arts-focused, so do not routinely pitch another current MVAC arts program. No routine follow-up should be created. Keep the organization eligible only if MVAC later becomes involved in a broader community/family event where a separate staffed attraction area could genuinely fit. In Desiree's acknowledgment reply, she also briefly let Jude know that Adventure Zone can sometimes offer a smaller Mini Zone setup when the full Adventure Zone footprint would be too large. This was presented only as future context, not as an attempt to push the 2026 festival after their decline.
